answer: The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so anyone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The horizon assignment is published and forge records each panel. Shards are assigned from the voyage graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1705 impostors cost 168 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
